title: Size Bound for the Transformation
statement: Let $$ be a CNF formula and let $w$ be a natural number with $3\leq w$. If every clause of $$ has width at most $w$, then the number of clauses in its width-three Tseitin transformation is at most $(w-2)||$, where $||$ denotes the number of clauses of $$.
hypotheses_covered: A CNF formula on n variables
A width parameter w with 3 ≤ w
The formula's width is at most w
